name: moonlight-vscode-clients
description: MoonlightCode editor clients: a shared control-API client, feature extensions, and the extension pack that installs them together.

scripts.compile: npm run link:local && npm run compile -w moonlight-control-client && npm run compile -w moonlight-core && npm run compile --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
